Plot method for features_percent_miss objects

Source: R/plot.features_percent_miss.R, R/plot_features_percent_miss.R
plot_features_percent_miss.Rd

Creates a bar chart visualizing feature missingness percentages for objects produced by features_percent_miss.

Generates a horizontal bar chart visualizing the percentage of missing values per column.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'features_percent_miss'
plot(x, top_n = NULL, ...)

plot_features_percent_miss(data, top_n = NULL)

Arguments

x

An object of class features_percent_miss.

top_n

Optional integer to limit to the top N features with highest missingness.

...

Additional arguments (currently unused).

data

A data frame, tibble, or the output of `features_percent_miss()`.

Value

A ggplot object representing feature missingness.

A ggplot object.

Examples

res <- features_percent_miss(mtcars)
plot(res)


df <- data.frame(a = c(1, 2, NA, 4), b = c(NA, NA, 3, 4))
plot_features_percent_miss(df)
